is_anopheles.evidence: The study analyzed field populations of Anopheles arabiensis, Anopheles gambiae s.s., and Anopheles merus collected across Zanzibar (page 1, Abstract; page 5, Table 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Screened sub-samples for kdr target site mutations (1014F and 1014S) and ace-1R (G119S/G280S) using TaqMan allelic discrimination assays and sodium channel sequencing (page 3, Methods; page 7, Results).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Reports that none of the resistance alleles (1014F, 1014S, ace-1R) were detected among tested mosquitoes (Unguja N = 120; Pemba N = 251; total N = 371), establishing 100% wild-type / 0% resistant allele frequency across 371 genotyped mosquitoes (page 7).

african_field_population.evidence: Larvae were collected from breeding pools on Unguja and Pemba islands, Zanzibar, Tanzania, between 2011 and 2013 and reared to adults (page 2, Insect collections).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical research article presenting original field bioassays, molecular species identification, genotyping, and transcriptomic analyses.

sub_country_location.evidence: Collections were made from named sites on Unguja (Mwera, Chuini, Kilimani, Cheju) and Pemba (Pujini, Kiungoni, Uwandani, Mangwena, Tumbe, Chwale) with geographic map shown in Figure 1 (pages 2, 3, 5).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected during the main rainy season (April/May) in 2011, 2012, and 2013 (page 2, Insect collections).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The paper reports original field larval collections and bioassay/genotyping work conducted specifically for this study.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype frequency summary data (0% resistant allele frequency across 120 Unguja and 251 Pemba mosquitoes) are reported directly in the main text on page 7.

assessment.summary: This study monitored pyrethroid, DDT, and bendiocarb resistance in Anopheles arabiensis (and sympatric complex species) across Unguja and Pemba islands in Zanzibar between 2011 and 2013. Target-site genotyping for Vgsc 1014F, 1014S, and Ace-1 G280S showed complete absence of these mutations (0% frequency in 120 Unguja and 251 Pemba samples). Resistance was found to be mediated by metabolic mechanisms, particularly over-expression of P450 monooxygenases (CYP4G16).
